title: Quantile Regression for Distributional Reward Models in RLHF
reasoning: The paper introduces a novel reward modeling technique (QRM) using quantile regression to better capture the distribution of human preferences in RLHF. While the work evaluates the model on 'Safety' benchmarks and mentions 'human values' and 'ethics' as motivations for alignment, its primary contribution is a statistical method for reward estimation rather than an evaluation or benchmarking of religion, morals, or ethical systems themselves.
